html:
Anti theft window tint helps to keep you, your passengers and your valuables safe. Below is information on how our films act as anti theft car window film and the added benefits of having anti theft glass film applied to your car windows.

For almost 50 years Tint a Car has been supplying Australians with all their tinting needs. In addition to car window tinting, we also offer home and commercial window tinting too, as well as state-of-the-art Paint Protection, Paint Protection Film, Car Wraps and car care products. We have ‘No Interest Ever’ finance options available, are members of the Window Film Association of Australia and our films (exclusive to us) are sourced from the largest supplier of window film in the world. Here is how anti theft glass film works and why our films are a great option if you’re looking for anti theft car window film

How Does Anti Theft Car Window Film Work?

The way that anti theft car window film works is that if a window is broken or shattered, the anti theft glass film holds the glass together, making it hard to gain entry into your car. All the films in our range can be used as anti theft car window film in addition to the many other benefits they have (which we list below). Black Panther, our high-performance window film is ideal as an anti theft glass film as it features molecular technology that is engineered to reinforce vehicle glass if it is shattered.

Other Benefits Of Anti Theft Glass Film

The anti theft car window films in our range also offer additional benefits that make them an even better investment. Benefits include:

  • Privacy (Octane is our darkest legal tint that provides the ultimate in privacy)
  • Protection for you, your passengers and your car’s interior from the damage caused by harmful UV rays
  • Reduction in glare (up to 63%)
  • Improved visibility and clarity
  • Increased durability and scratch resistance

Get A Quote For Anti Theft Glass Film Today

Call 13 TINT or get in touch with your nearest store to speak with your local window tinting team about the best anti theft car window film and to arrange a quote.
